Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 10: the slip of [[Lars' Protocol Droid (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid." While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.”), word for word the text of [[Lars' Protocol Droid]]. The label under the slip reads “ •K-3P0 (Kay-Threepio) (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
